|note_res_ELLS=Since the winners of the [[2025–26 FA Cup]] and [[2025–26 EFL Cup]], Manchester City, qualified for the Champions League by league position, the spot reserved for the FA Cup winners (Europa League league phase) was passed to the seventh-placed team, and the spot reserved for the EFL Cup winners (Conference League play-off round) was passed to the eighth-placed team.
|note_res_ECLPO=ELLS
